description: Run your Outseta membership business from workflows: keep people and accounts up to date, read plans, subscriptions and invoices, manage email list subscribers and support tickets, and log custom activities.

outseta_account_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an account changes in Outseta: its name, billing stage, subscription, people or anything else on it.

output.AccountStage: Its billing stage: 2 trialing, 3 subscribing, 4 cancelling, 5 expired, 6 trial expired, 7 past due, 8 cancelling trial, 9 paused, 10 created.
output.Name: The account's name.
output.PersonAccount: Its people, with which one is the primary contact.
output.Uid: The account's id, for Get account.

outseta_new_account_trigger.description: Runs when an account (a customer) is added to Outseta, such as a new sign-up. Accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.AccountStage: Its billing stage: 2 trialing, 3 subscribing, 4 cancelling, 5 expired, 6 trial expired, 7 past due, 8 cancelling trial, 9 paused, 10 created.
output.Name: The account's name.
output.PersonAccount: Its people, with which one is the primary contact.
output.Uid: The account's id, for Get account.

outseta_new_person_trigger.description: Runs when a person is added to your Outseta CRM: a sign-up, a list subscriber or someone added by hand. People already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.Title: Their job title.
output.Uid: The person's id, for Get person.

outseta_new_support_ticket_trigger.description: Runs when a support ticket is opened in Outseta, by email, chat, the website or a workflow.

output.FromPerson: The person who asked, with their email.
output.Source: Where it came in: 1 website, 2 email, 3 Facebook, 4 Twitter, 5 chat.
output.Subject: The ticket's subject line.
output.Uid: The ticket's id, for Delete support ticket.
